ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited will hold a Board meeting on October 22, 2026, to approve its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with an investor call scheduled for October 23, 2026. The trading window for company securities is closed from October 1st to 26th, a standard regulatory measure to prevent insider trading ahead of the results release. This document is a routine regulatory disclosure informing stakeholders of upcoming financial reporting and contains no red flags.
